title: Same world, two kinds of heredity
engine: research/experiments/SOUP/soup.Soup (our parameter-embedded Flow-Lenia, written from Plantec et al. 2023; not the authors' code)

frames.gif: ffmpeg fps 10, 520 px wide, 96-colour palette, Bayer dither

view: colour = fixed random projection of the 10 genome weights to RGB (viz.PROJ, seed 5); brightness = matter, scaled to each run's final 99th percentile; strip = genome spread (diversity.spread)
caveats: B16s0 was run under the name L16 and renamed; same arguments and hash.
Both worlds start from the identical state and use the identical mutation rng; they diverge because heredity changes which genome each cell keeps.
